effect.ascendant_arcana.archers_gambit.d: Faster draw speed of bows and crossbows.
effect.ascendant_arcana.cross_counter.de: Increases attack damage for the next attack.
effect.ascendant_arcana.echoing_damage.d: Deals damage every second based on amplification.
effect.ascendant_arcana.hobbled.descript: Slightly reduces movement speed and jump height.
effect.ascendant_arcana.sundered.descrip: Significantly reduces armor and armor toughness.
enchantment.ascendant_arcana.alchemists_: Increases the amplifier of all beneficial status effects.
enchantment.ascendant_arcana.ambush.desc: When you hit a mob after throwing this Trident, teleport to it.
enchantment.ascendant_arcana.archers_gam: Briefly increased draw speed after consecutively hitting a target. Stacks 3 times.
Slightly increases all damage dealt by physical attacks.
enchantment.ascendant_arcana.cleanse.des: Holding the shield up cleanses you of all status effects after a short time.
enchantment.ascendant_arcana.coldheart.d: Increases damage dealt by all cold attacks.
enchantment.ascendant_arcana.cross_count: Blocking an attack immediately after raising the shield grants a brief damage bonus for the next attack.
enchantment.ascendant_arcana.debilitatin: Slaying a mob transfers all status effects to the nearest enemy.
enchantment.ascendant_arcana.deflect.des: Blocking a projectile with your shield will shoot it back.
enchantment.ascendant_arcana.depths_curs: Drags you to the bottom of a body of water.
enchantment.ascendant_arcana.evokers_wra: Summons an Evoker Fang when the arrow lands.
enchantment.ascendant_arcana.heart_of_th: Increases damage dealt by all fire attacks.
Increases the damage dealt by all lightning attacks.
Decreases all incoming and outgoing damage.
Crystalizes nearby lava so it can be walked on.
enchantment.ascendant_arcana.hobbling_sh: Reduces movement speed and jump height, stacking 5 times.
enchantment.ascendant_arcana.inaccuracy_: Reduces the accuracy of bows and crossbows.
enchantment.ascendant_arcana.lifetide.de: On hit, sticks into the target and heals them for a short duration. You heal half as much.
Reduced base damage, increases damage dealt based on the number of arrows stuck in the target.
enchantment.ascendant_arcana.protective_: Instances of high damage are spread out over time.
enchantment.ascendant_arcana.rejuvenatin: Instead of doing damage, arrows heal for half the damage they would have done.
enchantment.ascendant_arcana.ricochet.de: Arrows ricochet, dealing reduced initial damage but increasing with each bounce.
enchantment.ascendant_arcana.sonic_blast: Holding up the shield charges a powerful sonic blast that ignores most forms of protection.
Slain enemies deal damage to nearby entities based on their maximum health.
enchantment.ascendant_arcana.strafe.desc: Allows you to sprint in any direction and reduces movement speed penalties while using an item.
enchantment.ascendant_arcana.sundering.d: On hit, sticks into the target and deals damage over time, reducing their armor.
enchantment.ascendant_arcana.surefoot.de: Significantly increases knockback resistance and reduces the strength of most slowing effects.
enchantment.ascendant_arcana.witch_heart: Slightly increases damage dealt by all magic attacks.
gui.enchanting.low_level: This Enchanting Table does not have enough power to decrypt this enchantment.
gui.enchanting.max_capacity: This item cannot support more enchantments!
gui.enchanting.no_item_body:
Enchanting has been completely overhauled. Each item has an enchantment capacity which cannot be exceeded and each enchantment requires various ingredients.

Treasure enchantments can be unlocked by placing them in a nearby Chiseled Bookshelf.
gui.enchanting.no_selection_body: Select an enchantment and place the ingredients below. Capacity can be increased with relics.
gui.enchanting.treasure: This enchantment is too exotic to decrypt without a copy nearby.
item.ascendant_arcana.enchanted_scrap.de: An item made from the scrap of enchanted items and materials, used to make more enchantments.
item.ascendant_arcana.relic.description: An item that can be infused into tools or armor at a Smithing Table, increasing their potential.
item.ascendant_arcana.restorine.descript: An item that acts as the universal repair ingredient.
item.ascendant_arcana.warden_heart.descr: One of the Warden's many hearts, salvaged in whole and useful for enchanting.
item.book_contains_treasure_body: Store in Chiseled Bookshelves to unlock!
